content: Hello! Welcome to Shoreline Furnishings. How can I help you today?
Hi, I just wanted to confirm if my payment for order #SR4871 has been received. I paid through Zelle yesterday.
Thanks for reaching out, Ms. Rebecca Tran. Let me check. I see a Zelle transfer of $1,225 from your account ending in 3911, received under transaction ID ZL20240612TX at 4:57 PM yesterday.
Yes, that's my account. The payment was sent from rebecca.tran@email.com. Can you confirm my delivery address too?
Absolutely. Your order #SR4871 is scheduled for delivery to 117 Lakeview Ave, Apt 3C, Chicago, IL 60613. We'll need confirmation ASAP so the delivery team can keep your Friday slot.
That's correct. Will I get a receipt emailed to me?
Yes, your receipt will be emailed to rebecca.tran@email.com within the next hour. Please check your inbox and spam folder, sometimes automated receipts get filtered.
Understood. Also, could you double-check that my phone number on file is 312-555-7284?
I've confirmed your contact number as 312-555-7284. If there are any last-minute updates, we'll call or text you immediately. Is there anything else I can help with before Friday's delivery?
